# pvecli ct clone

Clone a container.

```text
pvecli ct clone [CTID] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTID` | Source container ID. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-id`, `--newid N` | New container ID (auto-assigned if not specified). |
| `-hn`, `--hostname VALUE` | New container hostname. |
| `-pl`, `--pool VALUE` | Pool name. |
| `-ob`, `--onboot` / `--no-onboot` | Start at boot. |
| `-fu`, `--full` | Create full clone (templates only; default is linked). |
| `-ta`, `--target VALUE` | Target node (the source's disks must be on shared storage). |

## Examples

```bash
pvecli ct clone 101                                      # Interactive mode
pvecli ct clone 101 --newid 102 --hostname my-ct         # Non-interactive
pvecli ct clone 101 --newid 102 --full --target node2    # Full clone to another node
```
